ModuleDescription: Adds root-only Galaxy XR parameters to the Steam Link face/eye stream: true per-eye gaze and pupil dilation/diameter (GXRX uplink). Superset of the dedicated SteamLink module.
UsageInstructions: Use with the dedicated Galaxy XR FaceBridge Steam Link APK. Steam Link OSC output must use port 9015. Run gxr-relayd (root) and eyecap (shell) on the headset; GXRX must reach this PC on UDP 9026.
